heading: TravelCorridorSegment
text: A segment that is part of a travel corridor.

heading: TravelledWayLink
text: A linear feature representing a directed edge between two transport nodes in a network graph.

heading: TransportNetworkThing
text: Any transport-related geographic feature in the ITS transport-network domain. Subclass of its-location:Feature (and therefore geo:Feature).

heading: TravelledWayLane
text: A linear feature for a single lane along a travelled way.

heading: TravelCorridor
text: A linear reference for a travel corridor axis (multimodal or policy corridor).

heading: VehicleFlowRate
text: A non-feature quantity describing vehicle flow on a network element (not a geo:Feature; use its-location:LocationThing).

heading: PointOnRoute
text: A point feature locating a stop, timing point, or other position on a route.

heading: PublicTransportElement
text: Abstract element of a public transport system (line, route, stop, etc.).

heading: RoadSection
text: A contiguous section of a road in a road referencing scheme.

heading: MicromobilityPathSegment
text: A homogeneous segment of a micromobility path.

heading: FootpathSection
text: A contiguous section of a footpath.

heading: FootpathLane
text: A lane or channel along a footpath.

heading: RailSection
text: A contiguous section of a rail alignment.

heading: TravelledWaySection
text: A linear feature that aggregates or references a contiguous portion of a travelled way.

heading: TransportNetwork
text: A set of transport network elements (links, nodes, ways) modelled as an its-location:LocationGroup of member its-location:Feature resources.

heading: FootpathLink
text: A directed footpath link between nodes.

heading: TrackLink
text: A directed rail track link between nodes.

heading: MicromobilityPathSection
text: A contiguous section of a micromobility path.

heading: FootpathNetwork
text: A transport network for pedestrian paths.

heading: MicromobilityNetwork
text: A transport network for micromobility (e.g., cycle, scooter) paths.

heading: RoadLane
text: A lane along a road.

heading: TrackSegment
text: A homogeneous segment of track.

heading: PublicTransportLine
text: The linear geometry or reference for a public transport line (service corridor).

heading: Footpath
text: A travelled way intended primarily for pedestrians.

heading: NetworkElement
text: Abstract transport network element; concrete instances specialize using its-location:LinearFeature, its-location:PointFeature, its-location:AreaFeature, or its-location:LocationGroup.

heading: TransportAlert
text: A feature representing a transport alert with spatial extent described by ITS Location geometries.

heading: TravelledWaySegment
text: A linear feature for the smallest homogeneous piece of a travelled way in a given segmentation scheme.

heading: TransportNode
text: A point feature at which network links may meet or which anchors linear topology.

heading: ScheduledCode
text: A location code identifying a scheduled transport reference (e.g., trip, block, or timing group) in an external registry.

heading: PublicTransportSystemThing
text: Any public transport service or infrastructure feature.

heading: RailNetwork
text: A transport network for rail infrastructure.

heading: MicromobilityLane
text: A lane along a micromobility path.

heading: PublicTransportRoute
text: The linear geometry or reference for a specific public transport route variant.

heading: GroupOfLines
text: A group of public transport lines modelled as an its-location:LocationGroup.

heading: MicromobilityPath
text: A travelled way intended for micromobility modes.

heading: TransportAlertThing
text: Any transport-related alerting or event feature.

heading: RoadNetwork
text: A transport network whose members are predominantly road network elements.

heading: TravelCorridorLink
text: A directed link that is part of a travel corridor network.

heading: PublicTransportSystem
text: A transport network describing routes, lines, and related service elements of a public transport system.

heading: TravelledWay
text: A linear feature representing a generic travelled way (centreline or reference line).

heading: MicromobilityLink
text: A directed micromobility link between nodes.

heading: RoadLinkUserType
text: A code classifying users permitted or typical on a road link.

heading: RoadLink
text: A directed road network link between nodes.

heading: RailCorridor
text: A two-dimensional rail corridor footprint or influence area.

heading: Road
text: A travelled way intended for motor vehicle or mixed road traffic.

heading: RoadSegment
text: A homogeneous segment of a road.

heading: Junction
text: A transport node where two or more travelled ways or links connect.

heading: FootpathSegment
text: A homogeneous segment of a footpath.

heading: RoutePoint
text: A point feature along a route alignment (e.g., shape point or service point).

heading: TransportNetworkObjectProperty
text: Super-property for transport network topology and composition.

heading: hasStartNode
text: The directed start node of a network link (topology), represented as an its-location:PointFeature.

heading: hasEndNode
text: The directed end node of a network link (topology), represented as an its-location:PointFeature.

heading: partOfTravelledWay
text: Relates a section, segment, or lane feature to the parent travelled way it refines.

heading: partOfTravelCorridor
text: Relates a corridor link or corridor segment feature to the parent travel corridor feature.
